The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy
 Criminal Petition No.5333 Of 2020
Order:

-
This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking quash of charge sheet in C.C.No.116 of 2018 on the file of the learned II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District.

entities.text: II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor.
3. The petitioner is the sole accused in C.C.No.116 of 2018 on the file of the learned II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District.

entities.text: II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He has been facing prosecution for the offences punishable under Section 353 IPC and under Section 58 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "FSS Act").

4. At the time of hearing of this petition, learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that this is a covered matter and this Court has earlier in Criminal Petition No.1432 of 2020 and batch as per common order passed in the said petitions, quashed the F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.
Therefore, he would submit that the petitioner herein is also similarly placed and he is also entitled for quash of criminal proceedings initiated against him.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would also fairly concede that this is a covered matter and this Court, as per the common order passed in the above batch of cases, has quashed the F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.
Therefore, he would pray to pass appropriate order accordingly.

6. As can be seen from the copy of the common order produced by the petitioner passed in Criminal Petition No.1432 of 2020 and batch, it is evident that this Court, based on earlier orders passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, has quashed the F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts.

7. Therefore, in view of the aforesaid earlier orders passed by this Court and for the reasons stated therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the charge sheet in C.C.No.116 of 2018 filed against the Kuttuboina Vara Prasad, vs State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 23 November, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164634114/
1 petitioner on the file of the learned II Addl. Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District, is hereby quashed.
